records.title: Deramiocel · Duchenne muscular dystrophy
observations: FDA's July 29, 2026 advisory-committee staff briefing described an original BLA Complete Response Letter, multiple post-study SAP revisions, and a prespecified-analysis sensitivity concern; its prior-SAP primary PUL 2.0 comparison did not establish robust statistical significance (FDA cites p=0.21 in the sensitivity comparison). This FDA briefing predates the August 24 amended application.

In FDA's HOPE-3 randomized-phase safety summary, hypersensitivity reactions affected 22/53 deramiocel subjects (41.5%) versus 8/52 placebo subjects (15.4%); serious adverse events were 1 versus 5, respectively. These are source-specific descriptive counts, not a net benefit-risk determination.
Sponsor separately reported PUL 2.0 p=0.029 under SAP 3.0, and an August 24 major amendment narrowed the proposed indication toward upper-limb function with a November 22 target.
records.challenge: Reconcile original SAP 1.1/2.0/3.0 timing and missing-data assumptions against the final amended indication, PUL effect relevance, FDA BIMO observation response, FDA CMC record, and 24-month open-label evidence. The July FDA staff briefing is not the later FDA final decision.

records.title: Molgramostim inhalation solution · autoimmune PAP
observations: May 27, 2025 FDA action was a Refusal to File (RTF) over insufficient CMC documentation, not a Complete Response Letter after substantive review. This is a material outcome-taxonomy correction.
Savara reported Phase 3 IMPALA-2 primary DLCO endpoint p=0.0007 at Week 24 and a 2.5% treatment discontinuation rate due to AEs, with those discontinuations described as unrelated to study drug.
Savara's December 2025 BLA was accepted for Priority Review in February 2026. On April 15, 2026, responses classified as a major amendment prompted an observed three-month extension to November 22.
records.challenge: Independently verify resubmitted commercial-scale CMC, batch comparability and complete safety/benefit data; a positive pulmonary endpoint does not establish approvability. Explicitly keep the 2025 RTF outside the CRL backtest outcome class.

records.title: Bezuclastinib + sunitinib · gastrointestinal stromal tumors
observations: Sponsor-reported PEAK trial: blinded-central-review median PFS 16.5 months with combination versus 9.2 months with sunitinib; HR 0.50 (95% CI 0.39–0.65), p<0.0001. This is a pivotal efficacy signal but is not an independent SAP audit.

Sponsor-reported Grade 3+ ALT/AST increase was 10.8% with the combination versus 1.4% for sunitinib; treatment-related AE discontinuation 7.4% versus 3.8%. Liver monitoring and label applicability are material safety review items.
May 28, 2026 NDA acceptance and Priority Review set the November 30, 2026 target, corroborated by the sponsor's November 5 SEC exhibit.
records.challenge: Verify locked PEAK SAP and event adjudication, hepatic-event denominator and severity, final label/REMS if any, completeness of treatment exposure and nonpublic CMC/inspection questions. No absent public deficiency may be inferred as FDA clearance.
